change_summary: Reject helper-only Rust source instead of manufacturing an empty exported main.
Carry explicit evaluation authority: task_oracle, wasm_runtime_diagnostic, structural_diagnostic.
Keep Wasmtime success and fuel consumption diagnostic-only; runtime execution produces zero empirical fitness.
Require task-oracle authority before advanced evolution can promote/select a candidate.
Preserve evaluation authority in analyzer feedback and scientific-interchange documentation.
Upgrade and lock Wasmtime from 48.0.1 to 48.0.5 after the existing cargo-audit gate exposed newly published RustSec advisories.

diagnostic_attempt.purpose: Temporarily materialized Cargo's exact Wasmtime 48.0.5 lockfile diff after cargo audit exposed pre-existing advisories.
diagnostic_attempt.note: The workflow-modifying diagnostic PR was closed and is not counted as remediation.

acceptance_met: An explicit candidate entrypoint is required.
Runtime and structural diagnostics are typed separately from empirical authority.
Fuel consumption is no longer a positive fitness reward.
Promotion in the advanced evolution loop requires explicit task-oracle authority.
The exact integrated tree is the same tree validated on the candidate and passed target CI.
scope_limit: PAPERS-01 remains open: rustc/JIT isolation, source/module byte bounds, Store limits and host resource enforcement are separate.
No claim is made that Wasmtime runtime completion proves task or scientific correctness.
